services.desc: If you are considering yoga teacher training, you likely have already experienced the profound physical, mental, and spiritual benefits of practicing yoga. Perhaps you’ve been taking classes for a year - or even 10 years! - and you’ve found that you’re craving something more than the 60-minute studio class experience. You want to surpass your limitations, increase your connection with your body, and gain a better understanding of yourself. You feel passionate about yoga and want to expand your knowledge of the practice to safely and effectively share it with others, to uplift your community. Enrolling in a yoga teacher training can be one of the biggest and best decisions of your life!
